title: Direct image preserves injectives
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. For a scheme $T$ let $T_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\Lambda_T$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $\Lambda$ on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\Mod(T_{\Et},\Lambda)=\Mod(\Lambda_T)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $\Lambda_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $u_*:\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)$ be the direct image, $(u_*F)(W)=F(W\times_VU)$ for $W\to V$ etale, with the $\Lambda$-module structure of the sections [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then $u_*$ carries injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of $\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$ to injective objects of $\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)$. In particular (the case $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$, where $\Mod(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)=\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]) the direct image $u_*:\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(V_{\Et})$ carries injective abelian sheaves to injective abelian sheaves.

proof.text: *The adjunction and exactness.* By [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] (with $R=\Lambda$), the inverse image $u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] defines a functor $u^{-1}:\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$ (the inverse image of the sheaf of rings $\Lambda_V$ being canonically $\Lambda_U$, so that $u^{-1}=u^*$ is the module pullback of the ringed-site morphism $(U_{\Et},\Lambda_U)\to(V_{\Et},\Lambda_V)$, which is flat), which is additive and exact and is left adjoint to the direct image $u_*:\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Both categories are abelian [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Lemma 0730, proof, first sentence ("In this case the functor f^* is exact, see Modules on Sites, Lemma 04JC"); literature/stacks-project/sites-modules.tex Lemma 04JC (lemma-flat-pullback-exact)

proof.text: *Right adjoints of exact functors preserve injectives.* Apply [lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives] to the exact functor $u^{-1}:\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)\to\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$ between abelian categories and its right adjoint $u_*$ (step 1): for every injective object $I$ of $\Mod(U_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], $u_*I$ is an injective object of $\Mod(V_{\Et},\Lambda)$.

source.place: Lemma 0730, proof, second sentence ("Hence the result follows from Homology, Lemma 015Z"); literature/stacks-project/homology.tex Lemma 015Z (lemma-adjoint-preserve-injectives)

proof.text: *The abelian case.* Take $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$. An abelian group carries exactly one $\mathbf Z$-module structure and every additive map is $\mathbf Z$-linear; since $\mathbf Z_T(W)$ acts on $F(W)$ through locally constant integers, a sheaf of $\mathbf Z_T$-modules is the same as an abelian sheaf and the forgetful functor $\Mod(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z)\to\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] is an isomorphism of categories. It commutes with $u_*$, which is computed sectionwise by the same formula $(u_*F)(W)=F(W\times_VU)$ on both sides [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. An isomorphism of categories carries injective objects to injective objects, so step 2 for $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$ gives: $u_*I$ is an injective abelian sheaf for every injective abelian sheaf $I$ on $U_{\Et}$.

source.place: sentence before Lemma 0730 ("In particular the functor f_* : Ab(C) -> Ab(D) always transforms injective abelian sheaves into injective abelian sheaves"), the case O = Z

lean.note: Existing upstream instance at line 96. Specialize A to ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ for the constant-coefficient module clause and to AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} for the abelian clause. Module-valued sheaves are equivalently modules over the constant ring sheaf: the constant scalar action extends uniquely to locally constant scalars by sheaf gluing. lowerStar is exactly precomposition with étale base change. All coefficient-category assumptions are instances, not geometric hypotheses.
